title: Restaurant-Style Fire-Roasted Salsa & Warm Tortilla Chips
originalTitle: Restaurant-Style Fire-Roasted Salsa & Warm Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 1 can (28 oz) fire-roasted whole peeled tomatoes (with juices)
1 large handful fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems
1/2 tsp ground cumin & 1 tsp kosher salt
Warm crispy corn tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Place white onion, jalapeño, and garlic in a food processor and pulse 4–5 times until finely chopped.
Add the fire-roasted tomatoes, fresh cilantro, lime juice, cumin, and kosher salt.
Pulse briefly 6–8 times until you reach a vibrant, scoopable restaurant-style consistency. Chill 30 minutes and serve with warm salted tortilla chips.
